input.summary: Add Client affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard on consent, no competitor assignment by TrueLink, and confirm change of control is not an assignment or termination trigger.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets on notice, made consent subject to a reasonableness standard, and confirmed that a change of control of Client does not trigger any TrueLink termination or re-pricing right. Our playbook requires internal reorganizations and M&A to proceed without vendor consent; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, provided that Client gives TrueLink written notice of such assignment. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to any competitor of Client. A change of control of Client shall not constitute an assignment or transfer, and shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
